description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Honeywell is hiring a PHP Developer to contribute to resilience-focused software and infrastructure initiatives. The role focuses on modernizing systems, improving reliability, managing infrastructure across staging and production, and delivering changes safely while collaborating with product partners and supporting junior colleagues.
PHP Developer modernizing systems on Google Cloud, managing infrastructure as code, fixing defects, and releasing resilient features

Responsibilities:
• Configure and manage infrastructure as code across staging and production environments
• Contribute to a Google Cloud rewrite designed to modernize existing systems and reduce technical debt
• Investigate reported defects by reproducing them, identifying root causes, and implementing durable fixes that prevent recurrence
• Work with product partners to evaluate cloud and architecture tradeoffs, balancing technical realities with delivery timelines
• Release Resilience changes safely behind feature flags and maintain reliable rollback options
• Lead technical design reviews for junior initiatives, offering constructive feedback and helping colleagues build confidence
• Carry features through documentation, implementation, testing, and code freeze while protecting system stability
• Review established performance patterns critically and recommend clearer, more maintainable alternatives when appropriate

Requirements:
• at least one year of experience in technology, software development, or a related field
• a working understanding of PHP development and software delivery practices
• The ideal candidate is organized, manages time effectively, and can balance several workstreams without losing sight of quality
• You should be comfortable taking responsibility for outcomes, including measurable results that may improve or decline based on your decisions
• Clear communication is important, including the ability to present technical information to leadership and discuss implementation tradeoffs with product partners
• A collaborative approach, curiosity, and a bias toward action are essential

Preferred:
• Experience with infrastructure as code, cloud environments, or Google Cloud is valuable
• Familiarity with staging and production workflows, feature flags, deployment safety, and rollback planning will help you succeed
